propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing agents to reference collision-prone four-character prefixes locally
the summary JSON schema, library, MCP, and CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape despite aliases being available in the resolved state
agents preferentially copy locally salient four-character prefixes in tracker commands instead of durable user-friendly aliases due to missing alias in compact summary output

pinned behavioral evaluation confirmed that adding the exact resolved alias to summary results independently produces 25/25 alias-based agent commands versus 25/25 four-character commands with alias omitted
summary results must addditively expose the exact resolved alias while preserving backward compatibility of ticket_id echo semantics and fail-closed behavior for ambiguous prefixes
agent guidance must affirmatively direct use of aliases for tracker commands after discovery and canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts like rebar-ticket trailers
